title.narrative: Multidisciplinary Education and Research Improvement in Technical Education

description.narrative: The development objective of the Multidisciplinary Education and Research Improvement in Technical Education Project for India is to improve quality, equity, and governance in technical education in select states and participating institutions. The project comprises of three components. The first component, improving quality and equity in participating institutions will focus on improving quality, employability, and equity in technical education in participating institutions in select states. It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening participating institutions to enhance student skills and employability; (ii) promoting equitable access; and (iii) promoting multidisciplinary education. The second component, improving research for better skills, entrepreneurship, and innovation will support better research and innovation outcomes, and address barriers faced by women in pursuing careers in research and innovation. It consists of following sub-components: (i) competitive research fund (CRF) and research hubs; (ii) developing incubation and innovation ecosystems; and (iii) institutional research and innovation capacity building. The third component, sector steering, including governance and internal and external quality assurance will support the states and institutions to build this capacity through peer exchange and training on a large scale through dedicated grant schemes. It consists of following sub-components: (i) quality assurance; (ii) governance; (iii) leadership training and academic careers; and (iv) project management and technical assistance.
To improve quality, equity and governance in technical education in Select States and Participating Institutions.

condition.narrative: (Section I, A. 1(b) of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall maintain throughout the Project implementationperiod, a National Project Directorate within MoE's Department of Higher Education, with a mandate and resources satisfactory tothe Bank, headed by a national project director staff in numbers and with terms of reference, qualifications, and resourcessatisfactory to the Bank and detailed in the Project Implementation Plan.

(Section I, A. 2) of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall vest responsibility for overall implementation of theProject at the central level in the Central Technical Support Group. To this end, the Borrower shall maintain the Central TechnicalSupport Group ("C-TSG") throughout the Project implementation period with a mandate and resources satisfactory to the Bank, andwith staff in numbers and with terms of reference, qualifications and resources satisfactory to the Bank and detailed in theProject Implementation Plan.

(Section I, A.1(a) of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall establish by no later than within one (1) month ofthe Effective Date and thereafter maintain throughout the Project implementation period, a National Steering Committee.

(Section I, C. 1) of Schedule 2 to the LA): For purposes of verifying/certifying the achievement of certain PBCs, the Borrower,through MoE, shall appoint one or more independent verification agent(s) under terms of reference and qualifications satisfactoryto the Bank.

(Section I.A.3) of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall cause each Select State to establish by no later thanwithin one (1) month of the Effective Date and thereafter maintain throughout the Project implementation period, a State SteeringCommittee.

(Section I.A.4) of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall cause each Select State to establish by no later thanwithin one (1) month of the Effective Date and thereafter maintain throughout the Project implementation period, a State-levelTechnical Support Group.

(Section I.B.1 of Schedule 2 to the LA): The Borrower, through MoE, shall, not later than within one (1) month of the EffectiveDate, prepare and adopt the Project Implementation Plan, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank, and thereafter ensure thatthe Project is carried out in accordance with the PIP as agreed with the Bank.

(Section I.B.4 of Schedule 2 to the LA): Not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date (or such other date which theBank has confirmed in writing to the Borrower is reasonable and acceptable under the circumstances), the Borrower, through MoE, inconsultation with the National Research Committee and other key stakeholders, shall prepare and adopt the Competitive ResearchGrants Operational Manual ("CRGOM").

title.narrative: Share of eligible UG programs accredited at participating institutions

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks eligible programs receiving accreditation and/or applied for accreditation. Eligible programs are AICTE approved UG programs at participating institutions that meet the criteria for accreditation as defined by NBA, as of the date of reporting. A program is accredited if the NBA has accredited it for three to six years. A program will continue to be considered accredited for six months after the date on which its accreditation expires, conditional on it having applied for renewal. If a program has been accredited by the NBA at any time previously, for three or six years, it will be considered accredited only if it receives six-year accreditation in subsequent accreditation cycles.
